name: AWS CodePipeline
tagline_ar: محرّك CI/CD مُنظَّم يربط Source→Build→Test→Deploy كمراحل (Stages) تحتوي Actions تتعامل مع Artifacts.
tagline_en: Managed CI/CD engine linking Source→Build→Test→Deploy as Stages with Actions passing Artifacts.

key_concepts.desc_ar: تدفّق مراحل يتنفّذ عند كل تغيير مصدر.
key_concepts.desc_en: Stage flow executing on every source change.
Container of sequential or parallel Actions (Source/Build/Test/Deploy/Approval).

key_concepts.desc_ar: خطوة تنفيذ (CodeBuild, CodeDeploy, CloudFormation, Lambda, ECS, Manual approval, custom).
key_concepts.desc_en: Execution step (CodeBuild, CodeDeploy, CloudFormation, Lambda, ECS, Manual approval, custom).

key_concepts.desc_ar: تُخزَّن في S3 artifact bucket وتُمرَّر بين actions (input/output).
key_concepts.desc_en: Stored in S3 artifact bucket and passed between actions (input/output).

key_concepts.desc_ar: CodeCommit, GitHub (v1/v2 via Connections), Bitbucket, S3, ECR.
key_concepts.desc_en: CodeCommit, GitHub (v1/v2 via Connections), Bitbucket, S3, ECR.

key_concepts.desc_ar: توقّف المسار بانتظار IAM principal يوافق (مع SNS notify).
key_concepts.desc_en: Pipeline pauses for an IAM principal to approve (with optional SNS notify).

key_concepts.desc_ar: Actions في مناطق أخرى عبر replication bucket و artifact stores متعددة.
key_concepts.desc_en: Actions in other regions via replication bucket and multiple artifact stores.

key_concepts.desc_ar: قيم ناتجة من action تمر كـ #{SourceVariables.CommitId} لاستعمالها لاحقاً.
key_concepts.desc_en: Action outputs referenced as #{SourceVariables.CommitId} in later stages.

cli_commands.cmd: aws codepipeline put-approval-result --pipeline-name my-pipeline --stage-name Deploy --action-name Approve --result status=Approved,summary=ok --token TOKEN

cli_commands.desc_ar: إعادة محاولة الإجراءات الفاشلة في المرحلة.
cli_commands.cmd: aws codepipeline retry-stage-execution --pipeline-name my-pipeline --stage-name Deploy --pipeline-execution-id abc --retry-mode FAILED_ACTIONS

when_to_use.scenario_ar: CI/CD مُنسّق بين CodeCommit + CodeBuild + CodeDeploy
نشر تدريجي مع موافقة يدوية قبل الإنتاج
when_to_use.scenario_en: Staged deploy with manual approval before prod

when_to_use.scenario_ar: تكامل مع GitHub عبر Connections بدون tokens ثابتة

exam_tips.ar: كل pipeline يحتاج artifact bucket في S3؛ cross-region يتطلب buckets متعددة.
exam_tips.en: Every pipeline needs an S3 artifact bucket; cross-region needs multiple buckets.

exam_tips.ar: Manual Approval يرسل SNS notification وينتظر put-approval-result مع token.
exam_tips.en: Manual Approval sends SNS notification and waits for put-approval-result with a token.

exam_tips.ar: Source من CodeCommit يستخدم CloudWatch Events (default) بدلاً من polling للسرعة.
exam_tips.en: CodeCommit source uses CloudWatch Events (default) instead of polling for faster trigger.

exam_tips.ar: GitHub v2 = CodeStar Connection (OAuth)؛ GitHub v1 = personal access token (deprecated).
exam_tips.en: GitHub v2 = CodeStar Connection (OAuth); GitHub v1 = personal access token (legacy).

exam_tips.ar: Actions من نوع Invoke (Lambda) مفيدة لخطوات مخصّصة (tests/notifications).
exam_tips.en: Invoke (Lambda) action enables custom steps like tests/notifications.
